## How we selected brokers

The supplied shortlist focuses on UK-facing providers, platform choice, costs and retail protections. We have not tested execution, deposits or withdrawals, or independently matched each proposed account to a current register entry.

Before applying, confirm:

- The contracting company and its current FCA permissions.
- Retail or professional classification and the product offered.
- Spread, commission, financing, conversion and non-trading charges.
- Deposit/withdrawal terms and the complaint route.
- Whether [FSCS protection](https://www.fscs.org.uk/) applies to your particular claim.

## UK CFD rules for retail traders

The [FCA’s retail CFD rules](https://www.fca.org.uk/firms/contract-for-differences) set leverage limits, margin close-out requirements, negative-balance protection and risk warnings. Check your customer classification; professional status can remove protections.

| Underlying | Minimum retail margin | Maximum leverage |
|---|---|---|
| Major forex pairs | 3.33% | 30:1 |
| Minor forex pairs | 5% | 20:1 |
| Major stock indices | 5% | 20:1 |
| Gold | 5% | 20:1 |
| Other commodities | 10% | 10:1 |
| Shares | 20% | 5:1 |

These are regulatory limits, not recommended position sizes. A broker may require more margin. Use our [position size calculator](/tools/forex-position-size-calculator) to work backwards from an affordable cash-risk amount.

## FCA protections explained

The [FCA Handbook’s CFD provisions](https://handbook.fca.org.uk/handbook/cobs22/cobs22s5) explain the detailed requirements:

- **Leverage limits:** Vary by the underlying asset, as above.
- **Margin close-out:** Account-level protection when net equity falls below 50% of the required margin. Individual positions may still lose money.
- **Negative-balance protection:** Limits retail CFD liability to the funds in the trading account.
- **Risk warnings:** Standardised disclosures include the provider’s retail loss percentage; trading inducements are restricted.

These rules do not eliminate market losses, price gaps or execution risk. Do not request professional classification just to obtain higher leverage without understanding which protections change.

## FSCS protection: what it covers

[FSCS investment protection](https://www.fscs.org.uk/what-we-cover/investments/) may cover eligible claims against a failed authorised firm. Its investment limit is up to **£85,000 per eligible person, per firm**, subject to the applicable rules. It is not insurance against losing trades.

| Protection | Purpose | Important limit |
|---|---|---|
| Negative-balance protection | Caps retail CFD account liability | Does not prevent losses within the account |
| FSCS investment protection | May cover eligible liabilities of a failed investment firm | Eligibility and firm/claim limits apply; excludes ordinary trading losses |
| FSCS deposit protection | Separate bank/deposit protection rules | A bank deposit limit is not automatically your CFD-account protection |

Do not assume compensation applies because a brand mentions the FCA. Check your company, product and claim category.

## Payment methods in the UK

Bank transfers, cards or e-wallets may be available, depending on broker terms. Confirm minimums, currency, fees, processing times, account-name rules and the withdrawal route.

Once the account and terms are appropriate:

1. Consider a small initial deposit you can afford to lose.
2. Request a withdrawal and check the actual charges and timing.
3. Confirm receipt before considering more funds.

A successful small withdrawal does not guarantee future payments or solvency. Check [forex market hours](/tools/forex-market-hours) for planning; payment-processing hours follow separate schedules.

## Red flags to avoid

- Missing legal names or mismatched website/register details.
- Guaranteed profits or “risk-free” leveraged trading.
- Pressure to deposit or become a professional client.
- Payments requested to personal accounts.
- Unclear withdrawal conditions or unexplained release fees.

## FAQs

### Is forex trading legal in the UK?

UK retail forex/CFD trading is available through appropriately authorised firms. Check the exact company, product permissions and your customer classification on the FCA Register; an international group licence is insufficient.

### Which forex broker is best for beginners in the UK?

Compare IG, Pepperstone, OANDA, CMC Markets and XTB for demo access, understandable fees, education and platform usability. There is no single best choice for everyone. Verify the current UK company and account terms.

### Is FSCS protection the same as negative-balance protection?

No. Negative-balance protection limits retail CFD account liability. FSCS may compensate eligible claims against a failed authorised firm under its rules; it does not reimburse ordinary trading losses.

## Final recommendation

Start with the five-broker comparison, then verify the company and product. Try the platform before comparing complete costs. Keep an affordable risk budget and avoid funding an account with money needed for essentials. Leveraged forex and CFDs can cause rapid losses.
